lead.t: Thyroid storm – an acute, life‑threatening decompensation of hyperthyroidism characterised by multisystem hypermetabolism, usually precipitated by a stressor in a patient with untreated or inadequately treated Graves’ disease or toxic nodular goitre.

snip.t: Thyroid storm – an acute, life‑threatening decompensation of hyperthyroidism characterised by multisystem hypermetabolism, usually precipitated by a stressor in a patient with untreated or inadequately treated Graves’ disease or toxic nodular goitre.
Past thyroid disease: Known Graves’ disease, toxic nodular goitre, prior thyroidectomy, long‑standing hypothyroidism — Underlying disease determines which crisis is possible.
